newsitem.title: USA: Reliv sets 10 percent stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Reliv sets 10 percent stock dividend.

text.p: Reliv International Inc said Friday its board of directors declared a 10 percent stock dividend, payable February 28 to shareholders of record as of February 14.
Shareholders of record as of that date will receive one additional share of common stock for every 10 shares held. No fractional shares will be issued and instead will be paid in cash by the company.
As of the record date, the company said it expects to have about 8,713,466 shares of common stock outstanding.
Reliv, which makes and distributes several nutritional supplements, said it also declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.01 a share, payable February 28 to shareholders of record as of February 14.
The payment of future dividends will depend on the Company's revenues, earnings, capital requirements and other factors, the company said.
The previous dividend amount was $0.015 a share. Prior to that, the dividend was $0.005.
